description: Use when the user is building a team, before saving to their draft or launching it. The user's team draft, the same one the Build-my-team page edits: the chosen team, the answers so far, the step it is on, what a launch still needs (progress.minimumsMissing), the page link that opens it, and, when the draft can be priced, its quote as it stands (no token: hire_team mints the one a launch needs). draft is null when there is none. Read-only. No cost to call.
name: get_team_draft

draft.description: The draft as the Build-my-team page shows it, with its link; null when there is none.

quote.description: The draft's price as it stands, when it can be priced; no token.

title: Get Team Draft
